codePaths: src/services/results-sync.service.ts: schedule range endpoint and gamePk result linkage
scripts/mlb-data-01c-2025-canonical-mapping.mjs: deterministic team/game/player dry-run and raw mapping write guard

authoritativeIdentitySource.reason: Repository code establishes MLB Official schedule/live-feed gamePk, team, status, probable pitcher and lineup contracts, but it does not establish an exact no-call person endpoint contract for all 1,469 source MLBAM person ids with position, bat side and throw side.

games.purpose: Acquire authoritative gamePk, official date, home/away teams, game type/status, doubleheader/game number, start time and venue metadata for all 2025 Statcast game dates.
games.deduplicationStrategy: Deduplicate by gamePk; reject duplicate response gamePk rows unless payloads are byte-equivalent and same canonical candidate.
games.failureBehavior: Quarantine failed game identities; do not write event_id or crosswalks for incomplete, duplicate or conflicting responses.

players.purpose: Acquire authoritative MLBAM person identity for every source pitcher/batter id.
players.expectedResponseIdentity: MLB Stats API person.id, if endpoint contract is verified later
players.deduplicationStrategy: Deduplicate by person_id; reject conflicting official identity payloads for the same person_id.
players.failureBehavior: Return NEEDS_ENDPOINT_CONTRACT_VERIFICATION before any person acquisition; no name-only canonical player linkage.

game.strategy: Use bulk or date-level MLB Official schedule reads, then reconcile gamePk to exactly one sport_events.id through existing provider evidence first and official date/team/start/doubleheader evidence second.
evidenceOrder: official date + canonical home + canonical away

player.strategy: Blocked until an exact MLB Official person endpoint or repository-supported bulk person identity contract is verified. Existing live feed/lineup contracts are useful supplemental evidence but do not cover all source person IDs as a certified person identity endpoint.
allowedEvidenceOrderAfterContract: other exact stored provider identity chain

gameCallsPlanned.retryAllowance: UNKNOWN provider limit; one retry per failed date/range with conservative backoff.

playerCallsPlanned.retryAllowance: UNKNOWN provider limit; no player calls authorized before endpoint contract verification.

totalCallsPlanned.minimumAfterPlayerContractVerification: 1 game range call + player contract-dependent calls
totalCallsPlanned.boundedConservativeUpperAfterVerificatio: 184 date schedule calls + 1469 individual person calls

cacheContract.storage: local durable acquisition cache before production persistence

rateFailureSafety.retryPolicy: At most one retry for retryable network/5xx/429 failures.
rateFailureSafety.backoff: Start at 2000ms and increase conservatively; do not invent provider rate limits.
rateFailureSafety.resumeStrategy: Resume from durable cache and manifest status; never repeat successful cached identities unless digest verification is requested.
rateFailureSafety.partialAcquisitionHandling: Do not persist crosswalks or raw mapping for incomplete acquisition groups.

game.finalRule: One MLBAM game_pk must resolve to exactly one canonical sport_events.id before any crosswalk or raw event_id write.

player.finalRule: Names may validate official identity but cannot establish sport_players.id linkage alone.

minimumEvidence: bat/throw handedness or explicit unsupported warning
no existing exact provider mapping conflict
duplicatePrevention: pre-read sport_players provider_ids and metadata exact MLBAM ids
block same person_id to multiple sport_players.id
canonicalPlayerCreationPolicy.gate: separate canonical-player creation authorization after acquisition, before crosswalk persistence for missing players

providerEntityMappingsWriteContract.versioning: additive rows with acquisitionVersion in metadata; do not rewrite historical source ids

game.guarantee: one MLBAM game_pk -> exactly one canonical sport_event

player.guarantee: one MLBAM person_id -> exactly one sport_players.id

rawCanonicalMappingWritePlan.batching: game_pk batches for event_id; source_pitcher_id/source_batter_id batches for player ids
rawCanonicalMappingWritePlan.writeCaps: cap expected touched rows to certified raw row count and exact mapped identity counts
rawCanonicalMappingWritePlan.readback: count mapped rows, verify no duplicate event identity collisions, verify no canonical player ambiguity, digest immutable sample before/after
rawCanonicalMappingWritePlan.idempotency: pre-read current canonical fields and skip compatible existing values; fail on conflicts

game.exclusionPolicy: If canonical defects prevent 100%, excluded games must be explicitly listed and omitted from feature construction without lowering the target silently.

player.preferred: All source identities required by 01D feature construction deterministically mapped
player.missingPolicy: Quantify canonical players requiring creation in the later acquisition phase before any feature construction.

season2026.plan: Reuse existing person crosswalks immediately, acquire new person IDs incrementally, and acquire 2026 game_pk identities through the same MLB Official game path.

flow: official identity acquisition only if new and authorized
raw canonical mapping after separate authorization

authorizationGates.reasonExecutionNotReady: Game acquisition is ready, but player acquisition still needs exact endpoint contract verification from repository evidence.
